name: Anand Rathi Share & Stock Brokers Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers Limited is a Full-Service broking company.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers Limited is a full-service brokerage house providing broking, margin trading facilities, and distribution of investment products. It caters to a diversified client base including retail, HNI, UHNI, family offices, and institutional clients. It is part of the Anand Rathi Group, which has a multi-vertical presence in financial services such as wealth management, lending, insurance broking, and asset management.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 84.1% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 30.1% of their holding.
